name: shell_control_service
title: Control service
description: Starts, stops, restarts or reloads a systemd unit the target policy allows, and returns the unit's status re-read after the action.

name: shell_copy_path
title: Copy file
description: Copies a regular file to a destination under the target policy's write roots, verified by reading the copy back.

name: shell_delete_path
title: Delete path
description: Deletes a file, an empty directory, or with recursive a directory tree under the target policy's write roots, exactly as its approved preview listed it.

name: shell_discard_git_changes
title: Discard git changes
description: Restores a repository's tracked files and index to HEAD and, with include_untracked, removes untracked files, exactly as its approved preview listed them. Superproject only: submodule work trees are never inspected (not their changes or checked-out commit); staged gitlink changes are seen.

name: shell_find_files
title: Find files
description: Searches a directory tree with bounded depth and results, by name glob, type and modification age.

name: shell_get_disk_usage
title: Get disk usage
description: Returns each mounted filesystem's type, size, used and available bytes and inode counts.

name: shell_get_git_diff
title: Get git diff
description: Returns a repository's uncommitted or staged changes as a unified diff, redacted and size-capped.

name: shell_get_git_log
title: Get git log
description: Returns a repository's most recent commits: hash, author name, date and subject.

name: shell_get_git_status
title: Get git status
description: Returns a repository's branch, HEAD, upstream, ahead/behind counts and changed or untracked paths. Superproject only: submodule work trees are never inspected (not their changes or checked-out commit); staged gitlink changes are seen.

name: shell_get_journal
title: Get journal
description: Returns the most recent journal lines of one systemd unit, optionally by time range and priority, redacted and size-capped.

name: shell_get_policy
title: Get target policy
description: Returns a target gate's version, principal, sandbox status and effective policy: roots, limits, services, repositories, commands with their templates, and privileged forwarding with the privileged helper's policy summary.

name: shell_get_service_status
title: Get service status
description: Returns a systemd unit's load, active and sub state, main PID, timestamps, memory, restart count and unit file state.

name: shell_get_system_info
title: Get system info
description: Returns the target's OS release, kernel, hostname, uptime, load averages, memory and CPU count.

name: shell_git_pull
title: Pull git repository
description: Fast-forwards a repository listed in the target policy from its pinned remote, refusing uncommitted changes to tracked files and diverged history, and returns the old and new HEAD.

name: shell_inspect_certificate
title: Inspect certificate
description: Parses every certificate in a PEM or DER file and returns subject, issuer, names, validity, days remaining, key and fingerprint; files holding a private key are refused.

name: shell_list_directory
title: List directory
description: Lists a directory's entries with type, size, mode, owner, group and modification time; symlink targets are reported, not followed.

name: shell_list_processes
title: List processes
description: Lists the target's processes with user, state, memory, CPU time, start time and a redacted command line, filtered and sorted.

name: shell_list_services
title: List services
description: Lists the target's loaded service units that its policy allows, with load, active and sub state.

name: shell_list_targets
title: List targets
description: Lists the configured SSH targets with their name, host, port and user, without contacting them.

name: shell_make_directory
title: Make directory
description: Creates a directory, and optionally its missing parents, under the target policy's write roots.

name: shell_move_path
title: Move path
description: Renames a file or directory within one write root of the target policy (same filesystem only).

name: shell_preview_delete
title: Preview delete
description: Reports what deleting a path would remove, without removing anything: type, entry count, total bytes, the first 50 entries and a hash of the complete list.

name: shell_preview_git_discard
title: Preview git discard
description: Reports what discarding a repository's uncommitted changes would restore and remove, without changing anything: counts, the first 50 paths and a hash of the complete list.

name: shell_priv_cancel_power
title: Cancel a scheduled reboot or power-off

annotations.title: Cancel a scheduled reboot or power-off

description: Cancels, as root, the reboot or power-off the host's privileged helper scheduled and has not yet requested; returns the cancelled action and its time.

name: shell_priv_change_owner
title: Change owner as root
description: Changes the owner and/or group of a file or directory as root (with recursive, also of everything under it) within the host's privileged write roots, exactly as its approved preview listed; returns the counts and the owner set.

name: shell_priv_copy_path
title: Copy file as root
description: Copies a regular file as root to a destination within the host's privileged write roots, backing up a replaced destination and verifying by read-back; returns the hashes, mode, owner and backup ids.

name: shell_priv_delete_path
title: Delete path as root
description: Deletes, as root, a file, an empty directory, or with recursive a directory tree within the host's privileged write roots, exactly as its approved preview listed it, after backing it up; returns the counts and the backup ids.

name: shell_priv_install_packages
title: Install packages as root
description: Installs, as root, allow-listed packages exactly as their approved preview resolved them, every package at its approved version, never removing any; returns what dpkg shows was installed.

name: shell_priv_list_backups
title: List backups
description: Lists, as root, the backups the privileged helper kept of what it overwrote or deleted, newest first: id, kind, original path, owner, mode, size, SHA-256, time and operation.

name: shell_priv_list_directory
title: List directory as root
description: Lists, as root, a directory's entries under the privileged policy's roots with type, size, mode, owner, group and modification time; symlink targets are reported, not followed.

name: shell_priv_make_directory
title: Make directory as root
description: Creates a directory as root, and optionally its missing parents, within the host's privileged write roots; returns its mode and owner.

name: shell_priv_move_path
title: Move path as root
description: Renames a file or directory as root within one of the host's privileged write roots (same filesystem only), backing up a replaced destination file; returns what was moved and the backup ids.

name: shell_priv_preview_delete
title: Preview delete as root
description: Reports, as root, what deleting a path within the host's privileged write roots would remove and back up, without changing anything: type, entry count, total bytes, the first 50 entries, the backup and a hash of the complete list.

name: shell_priv_preview_packages
title: Preview packages as root
description: Reports, as root, what installing, upgrading or removing packages would change, without changing anything: every package with its exact version, and a hash of the transaction.

name: shell_priv_read_file
title: Read file as root
description: Reads, as root, a bounded part of a text file under the privileged policy's roots, or its last lines, redacted; a binary file returns only its size and SHA-256.

name: shell_priv_reboot_host
title: Reboot or power off as root

annotations.title: Reboot or power off as root

description: Reboots or powers off the host as root: answers at once with the time the action will be requested from logind, 60 seconds later, unless it is cancelled, or blocked by a package operation or an inhibitor lock, first.

name: shell_priv_recover_packages
title: Recover unfinished packages as root
description: Finishes, as root, what an interrupted dpkg left unfinished, exactly as its approved preview listed it, without installing or removing packages; returns what dpkg shows was configured.

name: shell_priv_remove_packages
title: Remove packages as root
description: Removes, as root, allow-listed packages exactly as their approved preview listed them, keeping their configuration files; returns what dpkg shows was removed.

name: shell_priv_restore_backup
title: Restore backup as root
description: Restores, as root, a backup the privileged helper kept, over exactly the version its approved preview showed (that version is backed up first), with the recorded owner and the recorded mode within the host's mask; returns the modes set and the new backup's id.

name: shell_priv_run_command
title: Run command as root
description: Runs, as root, a command declared in the host's privileged policy with arguments matching one of its templates, exactly as its preview resolved it and in the unit it named, and returns its exit status and redacted, size-capped output.

name: shell_priv_set_permissions
title: Set permissions as root
description: Sets the mode of a file or directory as root (with recursive, also of everything under it) within the host's privileged write roots, exactly as its approved preview listed; returns the counts and the old and new mode.

name: shell_priv_stat_path
title: Stat path as root
description: Returns, as root, one path's type, size, mode, owner, group and modification time under the privileged policy's roots, without following a final symlink, whose target is reported.

name: shell_priv_update_package_index
title: Update package index as root
description: Updates, as root, the host's package index from its configured sources; returns apt-get's exit status and redacted, size-capped output.

name: shell_priv_upgrade_packages
title: Upgrade packages as root
description: Upgrades, as root, exactly the packages its approved preview listed, each to its approved version, never installing what was not approved nor removing anything; returns what dpkg shows was upgraded.

name: shell_priv_write_file
title: Write file as root
description: Atomically writes a text file as root within the host's privileged write roots, backing up what it replaces and verifying by read-back; returns the hashes, line counts, mode, owner and backup ids. Content passes through the client and its model provider, so generate private keys on the host instead.

name: shell_read_file
title: Read file
description: Reads a bounded part of a text file, or its last lines, redacted; a binary file returns only its size and SHA-256.

name: shell_run_command
title: Run command
description: Runs a read- or operator-tier command declared in the target policy with arguments matching one of its templates and optional standard input, and returns its exit status and redacted, size-capped output.

name: shell_run_command
title: Run command
description: Runs a read-, operator- or destructive-tier command declared in the target policy with arguments matching one of its templates and optional standard input, exactly as its approved preview resolved it, and returns its exit status and redacted, size-capped output.

name: shell_run_read_command
title: Run read command
description: Runs a read-tier command declared in the target policy with arguments matching one of its templates, and returns its exit status and redacted, size-capped output.

name: shell_set_permissions
title: Set permissions
description: Sets the permission bits of a file or directory under the target policy's write roots, and returns the old and new mode.

name: shell_stat_path
title: Stat path
description: Returns one path's type, size, mode, owner, group and modification time without following a final symlink, whose target is reported.

name: shell_write_file
title: Write file
description: Atomically replaces or creates a text file under the target policy's write roots and verifies it by reading it back, returning the old and new SHA-256 and line counts. Content passes through the client and its model provider, so generate private keys on the host instead.
